data.name: Romesh
data.gender_notes: Romesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the mountains, often associated with the god Rama and the sage Valmiki. The name Romesh carries the meaning “Ruler of the Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Romesh usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, resilience, and determination to overcome challenges.
data.etymology: Romesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Romesh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_sanskrit.name: रोमेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the lord and master of a chariot, like Rama, the god-king in Hindu mythology.

in_hindi.name: रोमेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The combination of Rama, a popular Hindu god, and Ishvara, meaning lord or god. In Hindu mythology, Rama is known as a powerful and just ruler.

in_tamil.name: ரோமேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The combination of Rāman, a name for Lord Vishnu, and Īśvaram, meaning lord or god. In Hinduism, Lord Vishnu is known for his power and protection.

in_telugu.name: రోమేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The combination of Rāmaṇu, a name for Lord Rama, and Īśvaraya, meaning lord or god. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is known for his power, righteousness, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Romesh holds roots in Sanskrit origin, derived from two words 'Rama' and 'Ish', meaning 'Rama (god) is Mine'. In Hindu mythology, Rama is one of the most revered gods and an ideal human being, known for his virtues of truth, loyalty, and righteousness. The name carries a deep sense of loyalty and devotion, often instilling a sense of responsibility and principled character. Romesh holds strong associations with the Hindu traditions and values.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Romesh also carries spiritual significance, connecting the individual to the divine being, Rama. It reminds us of the importance of staying true to our values, upholding righteousness, and maintaining a strong connection with god. Through the name Romesh, one is reminded of the divine presence within and the ideals to strive for in daily life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Romesh: The radiant one who carries the knowledge of the divine in his heart.

historical_references.reference: The name Romesh has been used throughout Hindu history by sages, scholars, and devotees who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Romesh remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Romesh, a teacher in Kolkata, India, shares that their name Romesh meaning "Ruler of the Mountain" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
